note: Hand-checked spellings of suit parts that match no catalogue item by name: the wiki's suit page writes the part one way and the item another. Each entry names the suit page, the part as that page writes it and the item it is. The build refuses an entry once the item leaves the catalogue, the suit page no longer lists the part, or the part matches an item without the alias, so the list stays short and current.
